title: Albert Einstein
text: Albert Einstein was born in Ulm, Germany on March 14, 1879, not Munich. He developed the special theory of relativity in 1905 and the general theory in 1915. He won the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics for the photoelectric effect, not for relativity. He never won any prize called the Golden Atom Award or Quantum Thinkers Award. He died in Princeton, New Jersey in 1955.

title: GPT-2 Model
text: GPT-2 is a causal language model created by OpenAI and released in February 2019. The base version has 117 million parameters. The largest version has 1.5 billion parameters. It was not upgraded to version 3.0. It uses a transformer decoder architecture, not an encoder. Its accuracy on specific tasks is not 97 percent.
